# 2026-10-21: cluster rule. The study that pools several banks in this person table (GSE17612 = Maycox 2009, PMID 19255580; clusters brain_other:19255580 and harvard per multibank_cluster_sets.tsv) contributes its 49 persons (27 SZ, 22 CTRL; all in set A and in expr14) to the Harvard row and to the 'other single-study' row, so those persons appear in both rows (columns A_persons_also_in_other_rows, B_persons_also_in_other_rows). Ishiguro 2010 and Gilabert-Juan 2015 (set B only; not in multibank_cluster_sets.tsv, lineage lane brain_other) are placed in 'other single-study'. Cohort rows: n, *_est/_lo/_hi from the person tables; *_model_* from the primary model refitted on the person table with those persons repeated in each cluster (a person can occur twice in that fit; B fit singular, between-cohort SD 0.008). Pooled row: each person once, spanning-study persons keep their own random-effect group; its n counts persons once.
